notes: The Graduate Admissions programme list (applygrad.stanford.edu/portal/programs) is an iframe that returns no usable text, so programmes were found through department sites. MS in Computer Science could not be collected (cs.stanford.edu robots.txt). University-wide TOEFL/IELTS minimums come from the Graduate Admissions test-scores page and are used only where the programme page refers to it. Stanford publishes the TOEFL minimum on both the 0-120 scale (tests before 2026-01-21) and a 1-6 scale (on or after); 'overall' holds the 0-120 value and 'scale_note' flags it. The Graduate School of Education programmes share one requirements page. No China-specific page exists.
